image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a rough, sandy rock surface. The chiton has an oval shape with visible segmentation on its dorsal shell plates, surrounded by a textured girdle. To the left, there is blurry yellowish marine vegetation or sponge-like structure. The lighting is diffuse, typical of underwater photography.
